_note: Stable error codes (snake_case). Services return these, never sentences. Spanish text: apps/web/src/i18n/es-ES.json errors.<code>.

auth_forbidden_role.meaning: Role does not allow the action (refusal recorded)

revision_conflict.meaning: Stale If-Match; body returns current version

policy_out_of_range.meaning: Service level outside 0–100 or max below min

import_type_not_allowed.meaning: Extension/signature mismatch, macros, or unsupported type

import_mixed_origin.meaning: Synthetic and real data in one dataset

import_duplicate_file.meaning: Same checksum already uploaded; explicit decision needed

margin_below_minimum.meaning: Margin after the update would be below 15%; release blocked unless an admin overrides

margin_pvp_unavailable.meaning: Selling price missing or stale; margin check unavailable

cost_no_entries_in_stock.meaning: No lot entry with remaining stock; no update request is created

override_admin_required.meaning: Only an admin may replace the median

policy_override_requires_approval.meaning: Override saved as pending; the recommendation stays in force

policy_override_self_approval.meaning: The requester cannot approve their own override

stocking_floor_required.meaning: An always-stocked product needs a floor of at least 1

cost_lot_lookup_unavailable.meaning: Inventory could not be reached; the cost-update request fails visibly and is retried

import_invalid_date.meaning: Date is not a valid calendar date

override_release_by_setter.meaning: The admin who set an override cannot release it

roles_last_admin.meaning: The last administrator cannot be removed

role_mirror_failed.meaning: A role change could not be mirrored to the purchasing side; it is retried

auth_csrf_invalid.meaning: The CSRF token is missing or invalid

downstream_refused.meaning: A downstream service refused the request

authentication_unavailable.meaning: Service identity could not be obtained

request_invalid.meaning: The request body or parameters are not valid

separation_of_duties.meaning: The creator or last editor cannot approve

not_an_approver.meaning: Only users with the approver role can decide

mfa_required.meaning: A recent second factor is required

version_conflict.meaning: The record changed since it was read

invalid_proposal_state.meaning: The proposal state does not allow this action

invalid_quantity.meaning: A quantity must be a whole number of zero or more

proposal_conflict.meaning: This week already has an approved proposal

invalid_cost.meaning: A cost value is not valid

invalid_user_id.meaning: A user id is not valid

invalid_terms.meaning: Supplier order terms are not valid

revision_required.meaning: The caller must say which version it edited (If-Match)

terms_invalid_value.meaning: A terms value is out of range or malformed

override_release_same_person.meaning: The admin who set an override cannot release it

median_required.meaning: The released value must be the lot median or the admin override

not_an_admin.meaning: Only an admin can set a cost override

negative_value.meaning: A value must not be negative

inventory_unavailable.meaning: Inventory could not be queried for the lots in stock

pvp_unavailable.meaning: The selling price (PVP) could not be queried

vat_unknown.meaning: The product VAT is unknown, so a net cost cannot be converted

negative_cost.meaning: A cost must not be negative

invalid_source.meaning: The cost source is not allowed

invalid_lot.meaning: The lot identifier is missing or too long

unknown_parameter.meaning: The forecast parameter is not on the approved list

unknown_exclusion.meaning: The demand exclusion does not exist

policy_override_pending.meaning: A request for that field is already pending

policy_override_not_found.meaning: The override request does not exist

policy_override_not_pending.meaning: The override request is not in a state that allows this

margin_unavailable.meaning: There is no selling price, so the margin cannot be checked

import_decompression_limit.meaning: The workbook expands beyond the allowed size

import_too_many_rows.meaning: The file has more rows, columns or sheets than allowed

import_missing_column.meaning: A required column is missing or the file is empty

import_unknown_kind.meaning: The data type is not one of the allowed values

import_ambiguous_time.meaning: The local time is ambiguous because of the clock change

import_dataset_state.meaning: The dataset is not in a state that allows this

import_nothing_to_activate.meaning: The dataset has no accepted rows

import_mapping_name_taken.meaning: A mapping with that name already exists

scenario_invalid.meaning: The scenario parameters are not valid

scenario_stale.meaning: The inputs changed since the scenario was computed

scenario_already_promoted.meaning: The scenario was already turned into a proposal

import_unknown_job.meaning: The import job does not exist

import_job_not_rerunnable.meaning: Only a failed import job can be re-run

local_load_type_not_allowed.meaning: The file is not a plain CSV or XLSX

local_load_file_too_large.meaning: The file exceeds the size or decompression limit

local_load_too_many_rows.meaning: The file has more rows than allowed

local_load_macros_or_links.meaning: The workbook has macros, formulas or external links

local_load_signature_mismatch.meaning: The file columns do not match the expected export

local_load_interpretation_not_acknowledg.meaning: Tax and price interpretation was not confirmed

local_load_inventory_required.meaning: Movements need the inventory loaded first

local_load_unreachable.meaning: The local loader could not be reached

local_load_platform_unreachable.meaning: Data was parsed but the platform did not accept it

local_load_unknown_kind.meaning: The file kind is not supported

supplier_possible_duplicate.meaning: A supplier with a very similar name exists

supplier_invalid.meaning: A supplier field is missing or not valid

supplier_merged.meaning: The supplier was merged into another

supplier_version_conflict.meaning: The supplier was changed by someone else (If-Match)

link_sku_unknown.meaning: The SKU is not in the loaded catalogue

link_cost_invalid.meaning: The link cost is missing or not valid

link_currency_mismatch.meaning: The cost currency differs from the supplier currency

link_not_found.meaning: The product is not linked to the supplier

bulk_criteria_invalid.meaning: Bulk assignment needs SKUs or a search text

bulk_preview_stale.meaning: The bulk preview expired or was already applied

bulk_conflicts_unresolved.meaning: Products with another preferred supplier were not resolved

bulk_file_invalid.meaning: The bulk file needs SKU and supplier columns

merge_same_supplier.meaning: A supplier cannot be merged into itself

merge_currency_mismatch.meaning: Suppliers with different currencies cannot be merged

merge_open_lines.meaning: The supplier has lines in open proposals

review_item_not_found.meaning: The review item does not exist

review_item_closed.meaning: The review item was already resolved

payload_too_large.meaning: The request body is larger than a supplier, terms or link change may be

idempotency_key_reuse.meaning: The Idempotency-Key was already used with different content

invalid_idempotency_key.meaning: The Idempotency-Key is too long or has control characters

fx_rate_missing.meaning: No stored exchange rate for the supplier currency

proposal_has_deactivated_supplier.meaning: A proposal line belongs to a deactivated supplier

fx_rate_stale.meaning: The stored exchange rate is older than 7 days

import_sku_required.meaning: The row has no SKU (a variant id was supplied instead)

import_unknown_sku.meaning: The SKU is not in the synchronised catalogue

import_ambiguous_sku.meaning: The SKU matches more than one product

import_erp_export_refused.meaning: The file looks like an ERP export, which is local-only

import_self_approval.meaning: The uploader or validator cannot activate this dataset

import_conflict.meaning: Another activation or rollback ran at the same time

import_reason_required.meaning: A reason (a choice from the list) is required

import_reason_invalid.meaning: The reason is not in the list, or its detail is longer than 100 characters

sku_unknown.meaning: The SKU matches no product in the loaded catalogue

sku_ambiguous.meaning: The SKU matches more than one product (also by case or spacing), so none is chosen

policy_overlap.meaning: A revision of this policy or budget cap is already scheduled after the chosen date

exclusion_reason_invalid.meaning: The exclusion reason is not in the list, or its detail is too long
